classical_foundation.measure_statement: Q_{a,b} is a Haar-preserving homeomorphism of Z_2
classical_foundation.ownership: parity-vector conjugacy and its odd ax+b extension are classical prior work, not a novelty claim of C174

first_return_theorem.exceptional_point: x_*=-b/a is odd, maps to zero in one tick, and never returns
first_return_theorem.exceptional_set: the points whose parity strings contain only finitely many ones; countable, Haar-null, and includes x_*
first_return_theorem.iid_law: successive return times are iid geometric with weights 2^{-k}
first_return_theorem.ordinary_artin_mazur_status: undefined for R because Fix(R) is countably infinite
first_return_theorem.recurrent_domain: O_infty consists of odd points with infinitely many parity ones and has full conditional Haar measure in O
first_return_theorem.return_time: tau(x)=v_2(a*x+b) in {1,2,...}, except x_*=-b/a where tau=infinity
first_return_theorem.symbolic_model: R on O_infty is conjugate to the one-sided full shift on alphabet k>=1

fixed_word_theorem.denominator_status: 2^n-a^{s_n} is odd and hence a unit in Z_2

integrity.hard_gate: derive return renewal, restore the original clock, and test parameter sensitivity without target data

inverse_conjugacy_sentinels.finite_tail_rule: finite parity prefix followed by all zeros is evaluated exactly by the classical inverse series

operator_boundary.natural_extension: the two-sided inverse-limit extension is same-clock unitary but changes phase space
operator_boundary.wold_model: U is unitarily equivalent to I_C direct_sum S^{(aleph_0)}

parameter_and_boundary_audit.b_redundancy: multiplication h_b(x)=b*x conjugates T_{a,1} to T_{a,b}
parameter_and_boundary_audit.even_a_boundary: if a is even and b odd, the odd numerator a*x+b is odd and division by two leaves Z_2
parameter_and_boundary_audit.even_b_boundary: if a is odd and b even, the odd numerator a*x+b is odd and division by two leaves Z_2
parameter_and_boundary_audit.odd_parameter_blindness: all unweighted counts, stability sums, return laws, and roof recovery formulas are identical for every odd a,b

three_x_plus_one_boundary.claim: this legal Z_2 cycle is not a positive-integer Collatz orbit and gives no progress on the 3x+1 conjecture

source_lock.allowed_data: odd a,b; parity branches; Haar measure; exact algebra; finite regression sentinels
source_lock.arithmetic_origin: intrinsic dyadic local arithmetic only; no rational-prime or prime-power correspondence
source_lock.clock: one branch application of T_{a,b} is one original-clock tick
source_lock.determinant_convention: classical Artin--Mazur exponential and the explicitly declared stability-weighted exponential
source_lock.forbidden_data: prime tables, target zeros or divisors, arithmetic local factors, Euler factors, root numbers, automorphy, Hilbert--Polya, and Route B
source_lock.map: T_{a,b}(x)=x/2 for even x and (a*x+b)/2 for odd x
source_lock.normalization: unweighted fixed-point cardinality and reciprocal 2-adic derivative stability
source_lock.parameter_family: odd integers a and b, frozen before all validation
source_lock.phase_space: Z_2 with normalized Haar probability mu
source_lock.precision: exact integers, rational numbers, formal power series, and 2-adic valuations only
